comment: The eight signal inputs get no family: the module passes whatever you give it. The sequence strip is a LedDisplayTextField, not a parameter (src/SongMode.cpp:47-70, 515-521), so it has no census position and is covered by a Note; the parser accepts digits 1 to 8, skips spaces, commas and tabs, and reads a hyphen between two digits as an inclusive range (src/SongMode.cpp:242-285). A learn button toggles: the first press starts counting clocks and the second writes the count into that row's length knob, clamped to 1 to 64 (src/SongMode.cpp:325-340). The fade starts early only where Fade Clock is above zero and Fade Time above zero and the next row differs (src/SongMode.cpp:359-377). The panel prints SONG MODE, CLK, RST, the digits 1 to 8 down the left, and Fade, Switch, Clock, Time and Out at the bottom; the length knobs, learn buttons and trigger jacks carry no lettering of their own. Layout is at src/SongMode.cpp:504-567.
